description: Venues in Malaysia with a recognised award on record: MICHELIN stars, Bib Gourmand, MICHELIN Selected, Asia's 50 Best and others, with the award year, cuisine, price level and a link. Filter by source (michelin, bib_gourmand, michelin_selected, fifty_best, other), year, neighbourhood and city. The list is national: without `city`, a question about Kuala Lumpur also returns George Town venues.

area.description: Neighbourhood or district name, e.g. 'Bangsar', 'KLCC', 'George Town'. A name Festiv does not know is refused, not guessed; a city or region word such as 'Penang' or 'Klang Valley' is read as a city.
area.title: Area

city.description: City when no neighbourhood is known, e.g. 'Kuala Lumpur', 'Petaling Jaya', 'Penang'.
city.title: City
